TYPE_CRITERIA.heading: A short label or title that names the document or the section that follows it - not a full sentence of content
TYPE_CRITERIA.paragraph: Running prose: one or more complete sentences of explanatory or narrative text
TYPE_CRITERIA.list_item: One entry in a list of parallel items - an ingredient, a feature, a task, an attendee; reads as one of several sibling entries
TYPE_CRITERIA.quote: Words attributed to a person or source - quoted speech, a citation, an excerpt someone else wrote
TYPE_CRITERIA.code: Computer code, a shell command, terminal output, or a config snippet meant to be read verbatim
TYPE_CRITERIA.callout: A warning, tip, or important note that interrupts the flow to flag something the reader must not miss

HLEVEL_CRITERIA.title: The title of the whole document
HLEVEL_CRITERIA.section: A major section heading within the document
HLEVEL_CRITERIA.subsection: A minor heading nested under a section

CALLOUT_CRITERIA.note: Neutral extra information the reader should be aware of
CALLOUT_CRITERIA.tip: A helpful suggestion or shortcut that makes things easier
CALLOUT_CRITERIA.warning: A caution about something that can go wrong or cause harm
